checks.label: Service Policies (from namespace)
checks.description: Service policies from the namespace apply centrally managed rules (geo-fencing, IP block lists) to all load balancers.

checks.label: Sensitive Data Policy
checks.description: Sensitive Data Policy masks or blocks exposure of PII, credentials, and other sensitive data in responses.

checks.label: TLS (Auto-Cert or Custom)
checks.description: Load balancer must serve traffic over HTTPS using either an auto-provisioned certificate or a manually uploaded certificate.

checks.label: HSTS
checks.description: HTTP Strict Transport Security header must be enabled to prevent protocol downgrade attacks.

checks.label: IP Reputation
checks.description: A service policy with IP threat intelligence categories must be applied to block traffic from known malicious sources.

checks.label: Trust Client IP Headers
checks.description: Trusting client-supplied IP headers (X-Forwarded-For) must be disabled to prevent IP spoofing.

checks.label: Geo Policy
checks.description: Service policies must block traffic from specific countries or regions as defined in the baseline.

checks.label: DDoS Mitigation Rules
checks.description: DDoS mitigation rules define thresholds and actions for volumetric attack protection.

checks.label: L7 DDoS Protection
checks.description: Layer 7 DDoS protection detects and mitigates application-layer flood attacks using request rate analysis.

checks.label: App Firewall Policy
checks.description: A Web Application Firewall policy must be assigned to inspect and block malicious HTTP requests.

checks.label: WAF Blocking Mode
checks.description: The app firewall policy must have blocking mode enabled to actively block malicious requests.

checks.label: Threat Campaigns
checks.description: Threat campaign detection must be explicitly enabled to protect against coordinated attack patterns.

checks.label: Malicious Bot Blocking
checks.description: Bot protection must be configured to block malicious bots, using either default settings or a custom policy with malicious bot action set to Block.

checks.label: AI Risk Mitigation
checks.description: AI-powered risk mitigation uses machine learning to detect and mitigate high and medium risk threats.

checks.label: API Discovery
checks.description: API Discovery automatically inventories API endpoints and detects shadow or undocumented APIs.

checks.label: API Definition
checks.description: API Definition enforcement validates requests against an OpenAPI spec to block malformed or unexpected calls.

checks.label: API Testing
checks.description: API Testing runs automated security scans against discovered API endpoints to find vulnerabilities.

checks.label: Bot Defense
checks.description: Bot Defense uses JavaScript and API signals to detect and block automated threats like credential stuffing and scraping.

checks.label: Client-Side Defense
checks.description: Client-Side Defense detects and blocks malicious scripts injected into web pages (Magecart, formjacking).
